lead_raw_text:
The structure of CrBiAu crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms—4 Cr, 4 Bi, and 4 Au—distributed across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements in octahedral coordination: Au and Bi each coordinate to six Cr neighbors, while Cr coordinates to three Au and three Bi neighbors, with neighbor distances of 2.8524 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Au and Bi octahedra, and edge-sharing between like octahedra (Au–Au and Bi–Bi).
